name: Leans left
text: One string is too short.

name: Cries into a watering can
text: Weeps beautifully, on cue, into a small brass watering can kept up one sleeve.

name: Apologises mid-villainy
text: Cannot commit a crime without a heartfelt note of regret.

name: Afraid of the chandelier
text: Is quite sure it is looking at them. It is, a little.

name: Never been on stage
text: Knows every part by heart. Has watched from the wings for eleven years.

name: Says everyone's lines
text: Knows every part and is generous with all of them.

name: Eats the props
text: Was told it was a prop. Has tested this.

name: Exits by the wrong door
text: Very confident about doors. Not correct, but confident.

name: Upstages the moon
text: Regards the paper moon as a rival and behaves accordingly.

name: Allergic to feathers
text: Sneezes at plumes, masks, and anything that has met a goose.

name: Only knows Act Two
text: Rehearsed one act, thoroughly. It is always that act.

name: Over-commits to death
text: Dies at length, in character, with the last words of a small opera.

name: Speaks in rhyme
text: Once a line starts to scan, nothing can stop it. Orange has been a problem.

name: Stage-whispers everything
text: Every secret is delivered at a whisper audible in the next county.

name: Falls in love with props
text: Gives the heart easily, and always to something with legs.

name: Winds down mid-scene
text: Clockwork. Runs for about eleven minutes, then makes a long, sad noise.

name: Corpses
text: Dies beautifully, then giggles. The trade calls this corpsing.

name: Forgets which play
text: Fully committed to a play. Frequently a different one.

name: Won't say the Scottish play
text: Will not name it. Calls it 'that one with the hands', spins thrice, and spits.

name: Takes bows early
text: Hears one clap and assumes the show is over.

name: Waves at the front row
text: Recognises someone in row C. It is always a cousin.

name: Answers the Prompter aloud
text: Hears the prompt, replies 'Thank you!', and then says the line.

name: Sleepwalks into the audience
text: Drifts off the stage during quiet bits and sits down in somebody's coat.

name: Tangles in own strings
text: Walks through the strings, then the scenery, then the cast.
